offering_description.value: Operates an online marketplace that connects consumers with licensed cannabis retailers and brands, and sells software and advertising tools to those cannabis businesses to manage sales, menus, marketing and compliance.

primary_products.value: consumer cannabis marketplace app; dispensary and brand software; online menu and listing tools; advertising placements

primary_services.value: digital marketing; compliance tools; e-commerce ordering support

customer_segment.value: B2B: licensed cannabis dispensaries, cannabis brands and manufacturers; B2C: adult consumers using the marketplace app to find and order cannabis products

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly software plans paid by dispensaries and brands; advertising: paid listings and promotional placements on the marketplace; transaction or usage fees: fees on orders and payments processed through the platform
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs the consumer marketplace and business software, taking in listing and subscription fees from cannabis businesses; service provider: provides marketing and compliance services to cannabis retailers and brands

geography_served.value: US national: legal cannabis markets across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: consumer marketplace, retailer software and brand advertising, sharing cannabis customers and technology

distribution_channels.value: online: consumer marketplace app and website; direct sales: sales teams selling software and advertising to dispensaries and brands

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: cannabis advertising, licensing and data privacy rules set by state cannabis regulators and federal and state privacy laws
